from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Only full lines in a non-background color are panel separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h)
                if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                and grid[0][c] != background]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rb) - 1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri] + 1, rb[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(cb) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci] + 1, cb[ci + 1]
            if c0 < c1:
                panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    # Repeat the panel containing the most foreground cells into all panels.
    def score(p):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = p
        return sum(grid[r][c] != background
                   for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
    source = max(panels, key=score)
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    tile = [grid[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0, r1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a, b, x, y in panels:
        if b - a != len(tile) or y - x != len(tile[0]):
            continue
        for i in range(len(tile)):
            for j in range(len(tile[0])):
                out[a + i][x + j] = tile[i][j]
    return out
